praise.name: PRAISE
praise.description: Start your prayer hour by praising the Lord. Praise Him for things that are on your mind right now. Praise Him for one special thing He has done in your life in the past week. Praise Him for His goodness to your family.

wait.name: WAIT
wait.description: Spend time waiting on the Lord. Be silent and let Him pull together reflections for you.

confess.name: CONFESS
confess.description: Ask the Holy Spirit to show you anything in your life that might be displeasing to Him. Ask Him to point out attitudes that are wrong, as well as specific acts for which you have not yet made a prayer of confession. Now confess that to the Lord so that you might be cleansed.

read_the_word.name: READ THE WORD
read_the_word.description: Spend time reading in the Psalms, in the prophets, or passages on prayer located in the New Testament.

ask.name: ASK
ask.description: Make requests on behalf of yourself.

intercession.name: INTERCESSION
intercession.description: Make requests on behalf of others.

pray_the_word.name: PRAY THE WORD
pray_the_word.description: Pray specific passages. Scriptural prayers as well as a number of Psalms lend themselves well to this purpose.

thank.name: THANK
thank.description: Give thanks to the Lord for the things in your life, on behalf of your family, and on behalf of your church.

sing.name: SING
sing.description: Sing songs of praise or worship or another hymn or spiritual song.

meditate.name: MEDITATE
meditate.description: Ask the Lord to speak to you. Have a pen and paper ready to record impressions He gives you.

listen.name: LISTEN
listen.description: Spend time merging the things you have read, things you have prayed and things you have sung and see how the Lord brings them all together to speak to you.

praise_end.name: PRAISE
praise_end.description: Praise the Lord for the time you have had to spend with Him and the impressions He has given you. Praise Him for His glorious attributes.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Play gentle sounds when transitioning between prayer steps

screen.title: Screen
screen.description: Prevent screen from dimming or turning off during prayer sessions
screen.not_supported: Screen wake lock is not supported in this browser
